description: List repository commits with filtering options. For one known resource, use the matching get tool.

first_parent.description: Follow only the first parent of merges

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

ref_name.description: Branch, tag, or revision range. Default: default branch.

since.description: Commits on or after this ISO 8601 datetime

summary.description: If true, return only high-signal fields (id, iid, title, state, web_url, …). Default false keeps the full GitLab JSON.

until.description: Commits on or before this ISO 8601 datetime

name: list_commits
